verdict.rationale: Whether a vault/SaaS provider uses customer data for AI training, and offers an opt-out, is a fair privacy-posture question for 1Password, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack addresses AI training policies, data-use commitments, or opt-out controls. The items on the CLI, SDKs, MCP servers, llms.txt and passkeys concern features and AI-readable docs, not training-data use.
